rule: published artifacts stay byte-identical; corrections are appended
found_by: reading the driver's own z-scores against its own label

entries.source_section_or_line: out['closer_to'] -- the binary PART_VI / PART_VIII label
entries.old_statement: each symbol was labelled PART_VI_gamma or PART_VIII_sqrt by whichever z was smaller
entries.corrected_statement: The label forces a binary choice where two of three symbols reject BOTH candidates.  BTC lands on gamma at z = 0.11; ETH rejects the sqrt law at z = 12.07 AND gamma at z = 15.93; SOL rejects the sqrt law at z = 16.50 AND gamma at z = 4.64.  'Closer to' is not 'consistent with'.  Correct reading: 1 of 3 consistent with one candidate, 2 of 3 consistent with NEITHER.  Third time this lane has printed a threshold verdict its own numbers did not license (ERR-HU-011, ERR-HU-019).
